title: Put a raincoat on a small-dog form and fasten its neck and belly straps under the body
instruction: Put the raincoat on the dog and fasten both straps, then let go.
context: Putting a raincoat on a small dog before a wet walk is routine in millions of dog-owning homes. The hard part is underneath: each strap hangs on the far side, so one hand must reach under the chest or belly between the legs, pinch the strap end, draw it round to the near side and press its hook patch onto the loop patch, while the other hand keeps the coat centred on the back. The coat must also go on neck end forward and lining in.
setup: Table at arm-base midpoint; x fwd, y left, z up (cm). Fixed white PLA dog form bolted at x 38 (body 12 dia, y -16..12, belly 17/back 29 up, neck base y 8, head +y to 40.5 up, 3 dia legs at x 35,41, y -1,-16; CAD in README). On marks (x 30.7,45.3, y -55..-25): 132 g yellow ripstop coat (30x32, grey lining, 2 mm EVA in 8 cm arc, navy neck +y, three 2.4x1.2x2.2 spine webbing tabs at v 3,15,27). On +x edge: 16 cm straps (25 mm neck v 28, 38 mm belly v 13.5, 5.5 cm hook) folded up; 5x4 loop on -x.
scoring: Score 0 if form moved >2 cm, either gripper holds coat/strap at end, or coat is backwards, inside out, or off back (spine >5 cm off x 38, outside y -19..15 or z 27..32 cm); unlisted states score 0. 0.25: on back; 0.5: spine <=3 cm off x 38 and neck end <=3 cm off y 8; 0.75: also >=1 strap under body (<17.5 cm up, <=5 cm off x 38, in leg gap) with >=3 cm hook pressed on loop; 1.0: both so, centred, jaws >=4 cm open, >=10 cm clear and <2 cm/s for 0.5 s. Real: ruler, top+side photos, video.
reset_notes: Peel both straps off their loop patches. Stand the coat in its relaxed saddle arc on the table tape marks behind the dog (lower edges along x 30.7 and x 45.3 cm, from y -55 to -25 cm), yellow outer shell up and navy neck binding at y -25 cm toward +y. Fold each strap flat back up the outside of the far (+x) half so its black hook patch faces outward. Return both arms to READY and check the bolted form is on its marks.
fidelity: Form rigid, fixed, 1:1. Coat: 18 rigid 3 mm panels on sprung hinges (0.05/0.03 N m/rad) + 3 fixed spine webbing tabs, no cloth solver; straps: four 4 cm hinged links. Sim pad-friction stand-in engages only on two-pad contact: both finger pads register PhysX normal force (>=0.05 N each) & 3D hulls contact opposite sides (<=1.5 mm) under closed inward PD clamp (>=0.4 mm each, >=1.6 mm sum); open releases. Hook welds on >=3 cm contact (<=1 mm, <=30 deg) + finger press (>=2 mm) for 0.25 s.
